name: configAria
label: Config aria
description: An object whose items are all aria properties in the format 'aria-*' : 'value'

name: autofocus
label: Autofocus
description: Causes the component to receive focus as soon as it has finished mounting.

name: bottomBar
label: Bottom bar
description: Whether or not to display the bottom bar containing the Ok and Cancel buttons.

name: description
label: Description
description: Additional content describing the field, usually to provide further instruction to the user.

name: disabledDates
label: Disabled dates
description: Array of disabled dates defined as `[ (DATE | DATE_RANGE)* ]`

name: firstDayOfWeek
label: First day of week
description: What day of the week to begin the calendar. 1 = Sunday, 2 = Monday, etc. Can only be a value from 1 to 7

name: format
label: Format
description: Format describing how to serialize/deserialize the `value` prop.

name: timeAgo
label: Time ago
description: Toggles whether or not to show the TimeAgo Preset Panel

name: timePicker
label: Time picker
description: Whether or not to display the time picker along with the calendar.

name: utcOffset
label: UTC offset
description: The UTC offset

name: invalid
label: Invalid
description: Specifies whether the current value is not valid.

name: isoWeek
label: Iso week
description: Toggles whether to use Leap Week with 53 weeks as needed for Weekly View Only (type : `weekly`)

name: label
label: Label
description: It's a label! All form controls need a label!

name: language
label: Language
description: User language preference. Used for moment date formatting.

name: name
label: Name
description: Name for the component. Any events dispatched by the component will use this name.

name: placeholder
label: Placeholder
description: Content to display when there is no suitable display value.

name: readonly
label: Read only
description: Specifies that the user cannot modify the value of the component. When passed as a string, true (case-sensitive) will be treated like boolean true.

name: recordSysId
label: Record sys id
description: Sys_id of the current record where the field is located

name: required
label: Required
description: Whether or not the user must fill in a value for this component. Can be specified as a boolean or the string true

name: tableName
label: Table name
description: Name of the table the reference field is attached to.

name: type
label: Type
description: Type determines the display view of the date-range-picker.

name: value
label: Value
description: The initial date/date-time value. This value must be the localized time, rather than UTC time.

name: helperContent
label: Helper content
description: If set, an iconic button with a popover appears next to the field label to display additional hint text to the user
